name: al-corporate-tax
description: Albanian corporate income tax (tatimi mbi të ardhurat e korporatave, often called tatimi mbi fitimin) for tax year 2026 under Law No. 29/2023 'Për tatimin mbi të ardhurat' as amended to Law No. 81/2025.
